notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature without summoning sickness you control.
description:
Cast Traitorous Greed with any target and hold priority.
Activate the enchanted creature by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Traitorous Greed and targeting the enchanted creature with the copy.
Resolve the spell copy, untapping enchanted creature and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
